name: Syndicated Loan 3
definition: Loan offered by a group of lenders (called a syndicate) who work together to lend an amount of money to a single borrower.

Lender.name: Lender
Lender.definition: Party which provides an amount of money available to others to borrow.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of the part in the syndicated loan.

Share.name: Share
Share.definition: Share of the part in the syndicated loan.

ExchangeRateInformation.name: Exchange Rate Information
ExchangeRateInformation.definition: Provides details on the currency exchange rate and contract.

AmountOrShareRule.definition: Amount must be present or Share must be present.
